sloka: अथ वा न्यस्तशस्त्रौ तौ वने मूलफलाशनौ ।भ्रातरौ हि नर श्रेष्ठौ चरन्तौ वनगोचरौ ।। ५.२४.४४।।।।
transliteration: atha vā nyastaśastrau tau vane mūlaphalāśanau ।bhrātarau hi nara śreṣṭhau carantau vanagocarau ।। 5.24.44।।।।

translations.english: Then an ogress called Ajamukhi said, 'Let her body be cut into lumps of equal pieces.
